title: Lyric Card
description: A lyrics sheet for herb’s friday beat. Tap lines to pick them and a share card cuts them in word by word over his own photos, in white Arimo blocks with wide justified gaps, grain and bloom, the way the edits on his board do. Save it as a PNG.
intent: Spotify’s lyric share, rebuilt in the lo-fi lyric-edit language of the reference board: justified blocks with big gaps, small centred captions, top-left builds and big words, over real night photos.
sources: herb reference board: lyric edits 859f (you dont have to be a staarr), 899 (cause I don't wanna be in love), e936 rain, 70e0 LA skyline, 7af8 big words, 95d9 small caption
